headlines.title: 1 Reason Starbucks Is Worth Buying in November
headlines.summary: Starbucks' customers are spending more per visit without big price hikes -- and that could matter more than the stock's premium valuation.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Unveils Global Stock Grants As Brian Niccol Maps Drive Thru Reset
headlines.summary: Starbucks (NasdaqGS:SBUX) announced new global employee compensation programs on 13 November 2026, including stock grants and quarterly bonuses. CEO Brian Niccol outlined a turnaround strategy that focuses on fresh menu concepts and a comprehensive reinvention of the drive thru format. The refreshed drive thru model is planned as a global template for future store development and operational changes across key markets.

headlines.title: Starbucks’ Unusual Options Activity Points to Bullish Institutional Sentiment: Should You Follow the Crowd?
headlines.summary: Massive institutional options activity surged in Starbucks (SBUX) on Thursday. A $96.3 million block trade used deep in-the-money calls for a short-term stock-replacement strategy. At the same time, LEAPS are used more often; the institution that made the bet could profit nicely.

headlines.title: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol explains how he plans to create an 'afternoon ritual'
headlines.summary: Starbucks (SBUX) CEO Brian Niccol joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss Starbucks' continued turnaround strategy, upcoming menu innovations, and more.

headlines.title: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold Starbucks Stock Post Q4 Earnings?
headlines.summary: SBUX's Q4 earnings beat, stronger comparable sales and cost savings fuel its turnaround, but revenue headwinds and rising competition call for caution.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
